نستهين (form X)
# نَسْتَهِينُ (nastahīnu) /nas.ta.hiː.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهَانَ (istahāna)
# نَسْتَهِينَ (nastahīna) /nas.ta.hiː.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهَانَ (istahāna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
